'''Amedeo''' is a male NPC who appears in [[Ragunna]], [[Rinascita]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Amedeo''' "Eyes of illusion reflected underwater, coveting Avinoleum above..."
:;'''Amedeo''' "...yet deceit draws breath, and truth drowns."
:;'''Amedeo''' It... it's his work! It has to be!
:;'''Amedeo''' We need to destroy these notes, old friends, or trouble will come knocking. 
;(First time talking to him)
:'''Amedeo:''' Hello... a plesant day to you here in Ragunna!
:{{DIcon}} What were you just reciting?
:'''Amedeo:''' Oh... nothing, just some giberrish.
:{{DIcon}} What do you mean by "trouble will come knocking?"
:'''Amedeo:''' Please, forget what you heard.
:'''Amedeo:''' I don't want to board the Pilgrim's Sale. I have a family to support!
:'''Amedeo:''' Forget these forbidden words. They're curses from a mysterious playwright.
:'''Amedeo:''' He cursed the people of Ragunna with his truncated sonnet verses, condemning everything here... and now, I'm the next target.
:'''Amedeo:''' I... I have a family to feed.
:'''Amedeo:''' Amedeo, forget it, forget you saw those words.
:{{DIcon}} Is there anything I can do to help?
:'''Amedeo:''' O merciful Imperator, I have fallen into the depths of unforgivable sin...
:'''Amedeo:''' Forgive my family, forgive this innocent stranger!
----
;(At Night)
:'''Amedeo:''' Ah, well... Right. Yeah... oh no...
:{{DIcon}} What?
:'''Amedeo:''' Lower you voice! Did you forget? This has to stay under wraps! Those who spread it around have already been exiled!
:{{DIcon}} I haven't said anything...
:'''Amedeo:''' From the sea, they shall walk upon the land. And now the land has become one with the sea.
:'''Amedeo:''' That line is definitely correct. Even though it's just one line, I've researched it for a long time! It's definitely from that playwrite.
:'''Amedeo:''' They say the original manuscript was destroyed by [[Order of the Deep|the Order]], which is such a shame- a real waste of a beautiful poem...
:'''Amedeo:''' Hehehe... the heavenly feast awaits me! Blessed, sweet lamb... the sacrificed maiden...
:'''Amedeo:''' Lower your voice! Amedeo! Do not grant her authority, balance will... the chosen garden...
:'''Amedeo:''' Curses... unblessed... praise them by name...
----
;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}})
:'''Amedeo:''' Oh... This... Huh? Why am I here?
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
:'''Amedeo:''' I don't know!
:'''Amedeo:''' Why am I here? I was supposed to be at home reading...
:{{DIcon}} You don't remember anything?
:'''Amedeo:''' No, not at all! Have we met before?
:{{DIcon}} Yes!
::'''Amedeo:''' Please tell me what I've been doing!
:{{DIcon}} No.
::'''Amedeo:''' I guess my mind must have wandered off... Maybe I had a bout of hysteria or something.
:{{DIcon}} Do you really want to know?
::'''Amedeo:''' ...No. No, forget it.
:'''Amedeo:''' Never mind. I'm not that eager to know what I've been up to lately.
:'''Amedeo:''' To hell with the Threnodian! I'm going home to get some rest.
{{Dialogue End}}
